title: Sexual-function check-in (FSFI)
description: The 19-item Female Sexual Function Index. Six domains: desire (2 items), arousal (4 items), lubrication (4 items), orgasm (3 items), satisfaction (3 items), pain (3 items). Used at baseline and at 3-month follow-up for patients reporting dyspareunia, after surgery affecting the pelvic floor, after menopause, or anytime sexual function is a stated concern. Item recall window: past 4 weeks.

scoring.note: Each domain is scored as (sum of domain items) × domain factor. Factors: desire 0.6; arousal 0.3; lubrication 0.3; orgasm 0.4; satisfaction 0.4; pain 0.4. Full FSFI total = sum of the 6 domain scores. Range 2.0–36.0. Lower = more dysfunction. Rosen et al. clinical cutoff for sexual dysfunction: total < 26.55.

interpretation_bands.label: clinical_dysfunction
interpretation_bands.patient_label: Sexual-function score below the typical clinical cutoff.

interpretation_bands.label: mild_concerns
interpretation_bands.patient_label: Sexual function is in a typical range with some mild concerns.

interpretation_bands.label: robust
interpretation_bands.patient_label: Sexual function is robust right now.

thresholds.message: FSFI total <26.55 — below the published clinical cutoff for female sexual dysfunction. Consider focused discussion at next visit.
FSFI pain subscale <3.0 — significant dyspareunia. Consider focused pelvic-pain workup.
FSFI total has decreased by ≥6 points compared to baseline. Earlier follow-up advisable.
